title: Values in both sorted arrays
prompt: a and b are each sorted from smallest to largest and may contain repeats. Return a sorted array of the numbers that appear in both, each listed once.
hints: With one index in each array, what do you do when the two numbers differ?
Move the index that points at the smaller number. When they are equal, record the number and move both.
Before recording, skip the number if it equals the last one you recorded.
checkLabels: A shared number is listed once.
Arrays with nothing in common give an empty array.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Lists a shared number once for every time it repeats.
Compares only the numbers at the same position in each array.

feedback: Trace one index in each array on the first check. Only the index at the smaller number should move.
